descriptions.ended: The programme has ended: end message on the Today card, no HOT badge, no trade button.
descriptions.loading: The page is waiting for its data: the header and grey placeholder cards.
descriptions.error: The data could not be loaded: a message and “Try again”.

descriptions.needs-kyc: User has not passed KYC and has no trading account yet. The Today card shows “How to start” (step 1 is the one to do) with the rate range and “Verify my account”. No account picker and no rates table.
descriptions.needs-deposit: User passed KYC but has not made a first deposit and has no trading account yet. The Today card shows “How to start” (step 1 checked, step 2 is the one to do) with the rate range and “Deposit now”. No account picker and no rates table.

descriptions.capped: Today's max coins reached: capped message on the Today card, plain “Trade now” button.
descriptions.no-trades-today: No trades yet today: 0 lots and 0 coins, with a hint to make the first trade.
descriptions.market-closed: Weekend (markets closed): the live “Trader … just earned … coins” line is hidden. It runs Sunday 17:00 to Friday 17:00 UTC (Monday to Friday, GMT+7).
descriptions.credited: All of today's coins are in the balance: the Today card reads “Credited to your balance” instead of the earning line.
descriptions.delayed: Programme that credits coins some days after the trading day (not used at launch; not tuned yet). The rule reads “credited 3 days after the trading day”. The Today card shows 0 lots and 0 coins all day even after trading, with no line under the figures, and today has no row in History until its coins arrive.
descriptions.first-trade: The user has just closed the first trade of the day and its coins have not arrived yet: 0 lots and 0 coins, with “Coins are being credited to your balance”. Lasts up to 15 minutes.

descriptions.single-account: User has only one trading account: a fixed field instead of the account picker.
descriptions.ineligible-selected: The selected trading account belongs to an MT5 group that cannot take part in the programme, for example an A-Book group or any group not listed in the programme config. Shows a warning and “Switch to an eligible account”.
descriptions.no-account: User passed KYC and made a first deposit but has no live trading account (only demo accounts, or the live account was removed). Instead of the account picker and rates: a short message, the rate range and “Open a trading account”.
